report.what: Head coach Kellen Moore said Tyson was limited at Wednesday's practice due to a chest injury, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.. Tyson missed the first seven games of the campaign due to a hamstring issue, but he increased his sway in the Saints offense from Week 9 to 10, upping his snap share (24 to 71 percent) and target count (five to 13). In this past Sunday's loss to the Panthers, he recorded an 11-80-0 line, but he emerged from that contest with a new health concern. As a result, Tyson's status will be monitored in advance of Sunday's contest at Chicago.

report.what: Tuten carried the ball 26 times for 88 yards and a touchdown and caught three of four targets for 25 yards in Sunday's 40-23 win over Tennessee.. It's the second time this season that Tuten has reached triple-digit scrimmage yards in a game, with both those performances coming since the Jaguars' Week 7 bye. The second-year RB capped the rout with a six-yard TD run in the fourth quarter, extending his scoring streak to four games -- a stretch in which Tuten has racked up 260 rushing yards and three touchdowns on the ground while adding a 9-128-3 line on 10 targets through the air. He'll look to keep rolling in Week 11 against the Giants.

report.what: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Wednesday that Addison underwent thumb surgery earlier this week and won't be placed on injured reserve, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.. Thus, the Vikings are expecting Addison to recover fully before the four games required of an IR stint, but in any case he will miss some time due to the thumb injury he suffered in practice last Friday and sidelined him this past Sunday at Green Bay. With Addison out of the lineup, Minnesota will be relying on Justin Jefferson, Jauan Jennings (calf), Myles Price, Tai Felton and Jeshaun Jones at wide receiver.

report.what: TEST (this didn't really happen). Brock Bowers went to the locker room late in the 2nd quarter vs Denver after a defender rolled up on his right ankle on a short catch. The Raiders list him questionable to return. He had 4 catches for 52 yards (11.2 fantasy pts) before he left.
report.means: If he doesn't come back you're stuck with his 11.2 for this game. The bigger question is the playoffs: ankle injuries like this usually show up on the next week's practice report, so until we see practice we'd drop him to about 60% for next week. Your title odds would go from 31.0% to roughly 27.9% if he misses time.

If he's limited or out, the best TE on waivers is Darren Waller (9.5 a game) or Mike Gesicki (8.4 a game). You'll get another alert the moment his status changes.
